items.title: What Eli Lilly Doubters Overlooked
items.summary: If you only glanced at Eli Lilly’s headlines this year, the drumbeat of new GLP-1 data, obesity trial wins, and fresh acquisitions might feel almost routine. Investors who held Eli Lilly over the past year are up 41.6%, including dividends. items.title: Nvidia CEO out — 10 stocks to buy before S&P 500 hits 8,000
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is down over 30% from the highs with CEO Jensen Huang stepping down, yet Blanke Schein Wealth Management CIO Robert Schein says the stock is still a buy. He also names Broadcom (AVGO), Apple (AAPL), and Eli Lilly (LLY) among his top picks before the S&P 500 reaches 8,000.
